test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Shreya said, “I have been feeling very hungry.”

options.text: Shreya said that she had been feeling very hungry.
Shreya said that she was feeling very hungry.
Shreya said that she have been feeling very hungry.
Shreya said that she has been feeling very hungry.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Shreya said that she had been feeling very hungry.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The transformation of the given sentence from direct speech to reported speech involves several changes based on the rules of reported speech.
 
• When reporting something in the past, as in this case, the verb tenses typically shift back one step. "**have been feeling**" (present perfect continuous) becomes "**had been feeling**" (past perfect continuous).
 
• The reporting verb "**said**" remains the same.
 
• The word "**very**" remains the same in reported speech.
 
• In reported speech, pronouns are often adjusted to match the perspective of the reporting speaker. In this case, "**I**" (first person) becomes "**she**" (third person).
 
• So, the reported speech version correctly conveys what Shreya originally said, maintaining the appropriate tense, pronoun changes, and reporting structure.

Therefore, **option 1** is the correct answer.
